items.title: Lillian De Pass Interview, 1960-06-20
items.q: Uncle Todd used to like to fight Nick

ctx.x: Kid Bunch tells me about that.

Yeah, they had a lot of the bands used to, you know, all the bands used to go in there and play. Of course, she made plenty of money, that woman, but there was different kind of people from the people down here. They always select, you know, the Creole people. And of course, I was a different set. We'd more like go to espionage, you know, just to see, to find out something. We wouldn't go into maybe a dance. My brother used to take me anywhere, and I'd take a good look, sis, and we'd look around and see. We'd…
Oh, about Ms. Cole, you said she had some kind of insurance business?
